options.description: Agents, the Inbox, mail and approvals. Turn off to keep only the multiplexer.
Fold the Working group of the agents view. F folds or opens a group, and the view keeps that choice.

The width of the agents view's list: a number of cells, such as 52, or a share of the view, such as 30%. Empty follows the screen. The < and > keys and a drag on the edge of the list change it, and the view keeps that choice.

The most rows a multi-line editor grows to before it scrolls: a reply to an agent or to many, a mail draft and a new agent's task. 0 keeps each editor's own: 8 for a reply, 6 for mail, 3 for a task. An editor never takes more rows than its view has, and alt+m in it takes all of them.
How the agents view shows its list on a wide screen: a column beside the focus, a strip of chips above it, or a strip for two agents or fewer. The \ key switches it, and the view keeps that choice.
Move task cards on their own when tuios sees their work move: a plan held and then approved, a fan check, a pull request. Off leaves every stage to you.
How many agents may work on this machine before Any machine starts a new one on another machine. Agents that work, agents that start, and picks not yet started count. 0 is no cap.
Alt plus left-drag moves a pane
Percent window animations run at: 100 as shipped, 200 twice as fast, 50 half as fast

options.description: Animate UI transitions instead of applying them instantly

Always confirm on quit, not only when processes are running
Copy a mouse selection to the clipboard on release
Matches one copy mode search keeps. The renderer walks every match on every frame, so a very high value slows a one-letter query over a long scrollback.

Hold this key to keep the focus on the current pane as the mouse moves: off, ctrl, alt

Frame the larger overlay panels, such as the command palette, in the border style
Cells of empty ground kept between two neighbouring tiled panes
Offer a session in the rail that holds panes from several machines, once a second one is reachable

Hide the scrollbar thumb on the pane border
Hide the minimize, maximize and close buttons
Title of the terminal tuios runs in, from the focused pane: accepts {title}, {index}, {cwd}, {session} and {workspace}. Empty sets no title
Polls per second while nothing is moving. Lower saves power; higher notices background work sooner.
Draw pane images as block glyphs when the terminal has no graphics: auto, octant, sextant, quadrant, half, off

Columns of padding each side of an overlay panel's content

Shell that new panes run. Empty picks one for your platform.
Milliseconds the prefix stays armed after a repeatable command. 0 turns it off.

Width of a column in the scrolling layout, as a percent of the screen
Lines scrolled per mouse wheel notch
